help.intro:
How to play:

Press any button to control the game. After each command, the game will advance a few seconds and update the image.

You can also build a sequence of commands and send them all at once.
help.player_commands:
/resume - Resumes the game in a new message
/print - Captures the current screen and sends it to the chat
/recap - Sends the last animation clip again
/status - Shows some status information
/help - Shows this help message
help.admin_commands:
/start\_game - Starts or restarts the game
/save [slot] - Saves the game to a slot
/load [slot] - Loads the game from a slot
/m [text] - Sets custom message (no text = revert to default)
